projects.name: Dorothy 2
projects.quote: Steady gross margin, continued improvement in Three Month Adjusted EBITDA of +$2.3 million since Q3 2024, and energized Dorothy 2 ALBANY, NY, August 15, 2025 - Soluna Holdings, Inc. (“Soluna” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: SLNH), a developer of green data centers for intensive computing applications, including Bitcoin mining and AI, announced its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2025.
